mechanism: Isotretinoin is teratogenic and lamotrigine may have reduced efficacy during pregnancy; combined use increases risk of unplanned pregnancy and fetal exposure due to potential lamotrigine level fluctuations and isotretinoin's strict contraception requirements.
action: Ensure robust contraception in females of childbearing potential; monitor lamotrigine levels as isotretinoin may affect metabolism; counsel on teratogenic risks of both drugs and pregnancy prevention.
